subject.title: [Feature]: Structured Callback Actions and Thread Context Inheritance for Agent Handoffs

question: Should OpenClaw add structured `sessions_send` skip/no-reply and announce routing/thread override parameters as a core A2A handoff contract, and what exact surface should own them?
rationale: The missing behavior is a public agent tool/API shape, not a narrow bug patch; current main already fixed a narrower thread fallback but still relies on model text tokens for the broader lifecycle.

options.title: Keep as A2A contract work
options.body: Use this issue as acceptance criteria for a maintainer-sponsored handoff API and fold related draft PR work into that contract.

options.title: Narrow to existing thread fixes
options.body: Close only after deciding the structured skip/action and routing override portions are out of scope or tracked elsewhere.

options.title: Split by lifecycle mode
options.body: Move announce suppression, parent routing, dispatch-only mode, and explicit delivery intent into separate canonical issues before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep as A2A contract work
recommendation.body: Use this issue as acceptance criteria for a maintainer-sponsored handoff API and fold related draft PR work into that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The maintainer-side comment already frames this as acceptance coverage for the handoff contract direction.
